introduce_situation: Lately, the Hermetic Order, which you happen to be a part of,
received a strange message said to contain a prophecy about the Order's future.
Unfortunately, no one could interpret it properly to this moment.
As one of the Order's prominent members, you think that this may be your big chance,
since you are highly skilled at divination,
having practiced spells of this school for years.
You could show your importance to the Order as well as advance in the Mages' ranks.
So, with great hope in heart, you enter the Order's secret temple, where the meetings take place.
However, as you walk into the splendidly decorated Main Hall,
you notice that you are not the only one to test your luck.
A wizard from a notorious rival magic school has also come to the challenge.
The Archmagister decides that the best option, since there are two candidates,
would be to organize several rounds, in which both of you will try do decipher the message.
The first to find the key correctly wins the contest and gets all the praise.
However, in order not to make this easy, the number of rounds will be decided based on your skill.
None of the contestants knows the exact number,
but since your skill level is pretty much the same as your rival's,
it won't bother you too much, you think.
To win in this contest, you need to correctly interpret the signs which the crystal ball shows.
Your rival will also try to decipher the same signs.
show_game_intro: To decipher the message you use an old technique - scrying with the crystal ball.
So both of you, aided by the Archmagister, have come to the ritual chamber.
On an intricately carved oaken table stands the crystal ball.
It is glowing with shimmering light.
While you are looking at it, the clouds outside the temple,
permeating through the opulent stained glass paintings on the gothic windows,
reflect in the ball in strange shapes.
In the center of the ball appears something that looks like a number,
but it cannot be seen clearly.
